description: This file defines CLI argument parsing functions for configuring NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) parameters, including epoch time, TA info, ephemeris data, polarization, and other NTN-specific configurations. It also includes conditional compilation for advanced NTN args.

methods.name: configure_cli11_epoch_time
methods.description: Configures CLI options for setting epoch time parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ta_info
methods.description: Configures CLI options for setting TA info parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ephemeris_info_ecef
methods.description: Configures CLI options for setting satellite position and velocity in ECEF coordinates.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ephemeris_info_orbital
methods.description: Configures CLI options for setting satellite orbital parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ntn_polarization
methods.description: Configures CLI options for setting satellite polarization info.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_ntn_config_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for NTN assistance info, including epoch time, TA info, ephemeris, and other parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_cell_ntn_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for cell-specific NTN configuration, optionally using existing config.
